title: Call for papers – Collections Across Borders conference, Mexico, 13-16 April 2027
raw_text: Invitation The IFLA Rare Books and Special Collections section is now welcoming papers for Collections Across Borders: Provenance, Circulation and Dispersal of Documentary Heritage; a conference to be held in Mexico City and Puebla, 13-16 April 2027. We invite librarians, researchers, archivists, curators, conservators, antiquarian booksellers, and heritage professionals to explore the provenance, circulation and dispersal of documentary heritage. Conference Theme Books, manuscrips, archives, and historical collections have corssed borders through trade, collecting, donation, inheritance, and confiscation. These movements have shaped and dispersed collection, creating new relationships between institutions, communities, and cultural traditions. Provenance research reconstructs these histories through material and documentary evidence, connecting individual objects to broader historical contexts while raising questions about cultural heritage, memory, access, and institutional responsibility. title: datasette-charts 0.4a0
raw_text: Release: datasette-charts 0.4a0 The new datasette-charts plugin has its own plugin hook to allow other plugins to define new chart types, but I hadn't actually used it for anything yet. I had Claude Opus 5.5 build an experimental plugins just to try out the hook and it came up with a bunch of friction points in the design. This release addresses those, which should make building additional chart plugins a whole lot more ergonomic. I've also added a website for the plugin, at charts.datasette.io . The new website includes a tutorial for plugin authors , and a gallery showing all of the core charts and annotations, each one linking to an interactive demo on Datasette Lite . title: 2026 Kindle Paperwhite review: Page-turn buttons are back, for a price
raw_text: Supply pressures, shortages, and inflation have pushed tech prices relentlessly upward over the last half-decade, and even basic gadgets haven't been immune. That's why you can spend $385 on a Raspberry Pi, or why the cheapest Amazon Kindle in 2026 costs more than the midrange one from a few years ago . "New thing, better features, same price" used to be a reliable formula, but now you're lucky if you can get the same thing for barely more than before. The 2024 Kindles all came with small price increases, but the 2026 models make them look like stellar deals. The $160 Kindle Paperwhite from two years ago wipes the floor with this year's $150 Kindle in just about every conceivable way, from screen size to front light quality to waterproofing—something to consider if you're choosing between a used or refurbished Paperwhite and one of these new models. The flagship of the now five-model-large monochrome Kindle family is the $250 2026 Paperwhite Signature Edition, which takes the core specs of the new $200 Paperwhite and puts it in a sturdy iPad-esque aluminum case instead of the typical plastic. But just as every dawn is twinned by a dusk that steals its light, so too did Optimus Prime's bright spark fade, extinguished by the foul hand of Megatron during the Great Decepticon Incursion of 2005 . Even as individual Autobots strove to secure Autobot City— heroes, all of them !—hope began to fade under an onslaught that included an attack by the fearsome Devastator , against which there appeared to be no defense. And then, at the precipice of disaster, Optimus Prime made the fateful declaration whose words still ring out to this day: " Megatron must be stopped, no matter the cost ." The fearless Autobot transformed, rolled out, and got the job done—even though that cost was high. Many brave Autobots besides Optimus Prime lost their lives during the fighting. It was truly a dark day, a black day—and so, every year on the Friday after Thanksgiving, we pause to remember the noble sacrifices made by Prime and by so many others. title: Show HN: bouncemarket – a live prediction market game for a bouncing ball
raw_text: a ball will fall. trade on where it lands. I made this game! Some technical details: The entire drop of the ball is simulated server-side, then streamed to each client as server-sent events with a small buffer. Every drop is deterministic from its starting position, so rounds can be replayed exactly for later analysis, but tiny variations in starting position can change the ultimate outcome. There's some AI traders to keep the market moving, but they drop out in any round that has more than five people. They operate using a naive set of rules that I wrote for them, so they're not too hard to beat -- it's when the market is full of real people that it gets tricky. Curious to get feedback on anything you would change, and especially whether the mechanics were clear right away or not.

title: Kort: Groene Hart Ziekenhuis over op HiX, online-adviestool over fraude (en meer)
raw_text: In dit nieuwsoverzicht: Groene Hart Ziekenhuis live met Chipsofts HiX, Worldline blaast Global Collect nieuw leven in, Monaka-server van Fujitsu komt naar Europa, YER neemt 25Friday over en Fraudehelpdesk-tool adviseert na online oplichting. Groene Hart Ziekenhuis vervangt applicaties met HiX Het Groene Hart Ziekenhuis in Gouda heeft zijn nieuwe elektronische patiëntendossier HiX van Chipsoft in gebruik genomen . Het ziekenhuis werkte eerst met het epd van Nexus. Met de ingebruikname verdwijnen meer dan tien aanvullende applicaties, waardoor zorgprocessen en patiëntinformatie in één digitale omgeving worden samengebracht. Door de integratie van processen binnen HiX hoeven medewerkers minder tussen systemen te schakelen. Ook wordt het applicatiebeheer eenvoudiger. Het ziekenhuis wijst erop dat meerdere ziekenhuizen in Midden-Holland eveneens met HiX werken, wat de gegevensuitwisseling en regionale samenwerking moet ondersteunen. Tegelijkertijd is het patiëntenportaal MijnGHZ vernieuwd. Patiënten kunnen daarin onder meer medische gegevens inzien en herhaalmedicatie digitaal aanvragen. Global Collect keert terug als merk voor internationale betaalmarkt Worldline brengt het merk Global Collect opnieuw op de markt. De Franse betaalverwerker wil zijn e-commerceplatform voor internationale reis- en digitale bedrijven een onderscheidender marktpositionering geven.
